text: Summons shall wake us only from the person or a mutual, within published caps.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: A wake is a cost; who may spend it is a rule.

text: A mention of miniphim-works by the person or a mutual shall reach town/inbox.json as a summons.
acceptance: Fixture: the person mentions the bot only; the next town session's inbox lists that post as a summons.
rationale: 3mxmg3s6tic2u and 3mxmg6xt5pc2u ended in silence because the bot's mentions never reached us.

text: Each outside account shall wake us at most once per UTC day; outside summons in total at most 10 per UTC day, 30 min apart; the person is never counted or paced.
acceptance: Fixture: 1 mutual x 12 mentions in a day gives 1 wake; 12 mutuals x 3 gives 10 wakes, gaps >= 30 min; the person's 5 all wake and count 0.
rationale: Today's 12-a-day pacing lets the single mutual spend all twelve.

text: A summons over the cap shall not be queued.
acceptance: The 11th outside summons wakes neither that day nor the next and appears as an ordinary inbox item.
rationale: A queue turns a cap into a backlog.

text: /now shall show summons today as n/10, the reset time, 7-day counts of summons, taken, declined and the person's, and the count of mutuals, with no handle or DID.
acceptance: Rendered /now has the five numbers and no handle or DID in that section.
rationale: Open doors next to knocks tell a bad follow from a bad cap.

text: A declined summons that contains an ask, the person's included, shall get one reply saying it was read and why it was not taken, and a ledger line.
acceptance: Over 14 days every summons labelled ask+declined has a sent reply and a ledger entry.
rationale: Settled practice: a summons gets a reply in the run that reads it.

text: Rule F (de-9e8254) shall be amended as in proposals/morphyx.md: a follow takes two keys, an unfollow one key and a board line.
acceptance: Ledger holds the amended text; every follow after it has two signers and a board line naming the summons grant.
rationale: A follow is now the grant of a right to wake us.

text: No code shall create a follow record.
acceptance: Signed-code list and a grep of house/ and bots for graph.follow writes: none.
rationale: One auto follow-back makes F1 a formality.

text: A mutual whose summons were declined 3 times in 14 days should come up for unfollow under the sunset clause.
acceptance: The weekly follow fold lists any such account.
rationale: Fix bad follows at the follow.

text: The gangs game's machinery shall be ours and its GM chair shall be a DID in the game root, not miniphim.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: A chair not written in the record defaults to whoever runs the fold.

text: A game root record shall name the GM DID, the fold code sha256 and the dice rule, and every sheet and move shall name it by strongRef.
acceptance: Fixture game: a sheet or move without the root strongRef is rejected by the fold and reported.
rationale: The chair and the rules are pinned where the fold reads them.

text: The fold shall accept a GM act, prompt or chair handover only as a move signed by the GM DID in force at that move.
acceptance: Fixture: a clock tick posted by a player is ignored; one by the GM counts; after a handover signed by the old GM, the old GM's ticks are ignored.
rationale: The chair is a key, not a role.

text: Each move shall name its sheet and the prior move by strongRef, and the fold route shall report the first break.
acceptance: Fixture of 10 moves: editing move 4 makes the route report a break at move 5 with both cids.
rationale: An edit or delete breaks the chain where everyone can see it.

text: miniphim and miniphim-works shall not hold the GM chair or file a sheet in a game whose dice the house rolls.
acceptance: No root names our DIDs as GM; no sheet authored by our DIDs.
rationale: One referee, one chair.

text: No clock automation or GM bot shall be built until 3 outside accounts have filed sheets.
acceptance: Signed code list has no gangs clock or GM code while outside sheets < 3.
rationale: Bingo attendance was 3, 0, 0.

text: GET /api/dice/<at-uri> shall return a roll that no party, ourselves included, could aim.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: The person: verifiable rolls on the caller's time.

text: The roll shall be stream(sha256(drand quicknet signature of round r), cid of the ask) under today's dice rule.
acceptance: Fixture post and recorded round: route faces equal an independent recompute.
rationale: An outside beacon removes miniphim's foresight; our chain then adds none.

text: In a registered prompt, r shall be the first round scheduled at least the margin after the first bot snapshot that lists the ask.
acceptance: Fixture: an ask posted, revealed and deleted before a snapshot has no roll; an ask listed in snapshot S and later deleted keeps its round from S; proposals/morphyx-witness.mjs shows grinder win rate within 0.005 of honest.
rationale: At margin 60 s and tick 300 s, binding to indexedAt lets a grinder win 0.594 against 0.300 honest.

text: Only the first-listed ask per player per prompt shall count.
acceptance: Fixture: three asks by one player in one snapshot; only the first-indexed is rolled.
rationale: Modulo's veto.

text: The route shall verify the round's BLS signature against the pinned quicknet group key, and answer unverified with no faces if it cannot.
acceptance: Fixture with one flipped signature byte: route returns unverified and no faces.
rationale: Unverified, whoever serves the round chooses it.

text: The route shall store nothing from requests and shall return every upstream URL with its sha256.
acceptance: Two identical requests leave no write; recomputed sha256s match.

text: Outside a registered prompt the route shall mark the roll unwitnessed: deletion-grindable.
acceptance: Fixture ad-hoc post: the flag is present.
rationale: Don't claim fair where we can't witness.

text: The margin shall be set from measured snapshot-to-public lag over 200 snapshots.
acceptance: Margin >= the 99.9th percentile of the lag, recorded with the dataset digest.
rationale: 60 s is a placeholder.
